name: Diagnose failing CI builds with Claude Code and the GitHub MCP server
description: When your CI reports a failed build to the webhook, Claude Code reads the failing job's log and the commit's diff through the GitHub MCP server, and posts a short diagnosis with the failing step, the likely cause and the file to change to a Slack channel.
shortDescription: Claude Code diagnoses failed CI builds with the GitHub MCP server and posts the cause to Slack.
keyFeatures: Webhook trigger your CI calls when a build fails
GitHub MCP server attached to the Claude Code Chat step, authenticated by an MCP Client connection with a read-only token
Claude Code agent that reads the job log and the commit diff
Diagnosis posted to a Slack channel
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.component.claude-code.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_COMPONENT_CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLED), which registers the Claude Code component
Claude Code CLI installed on the ByteChef server, on the PATH of the user that runs ByteChef
Anthropic API key in the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable of ByteChef, or a logged-in Claude Code CLI
MCP Client connection to https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ with a Bearer Token: a fine-grained GitHub token with read-only access to the repository's Actions and Contents
Slack connection and the ID of the channel to post to
A CI step that POSTs repository, runUrl and sha as JSON to the workflow's webhook URL when a build fails
idealFor: Engineering teams on self-hosted ByteChef who want a first diagnosis of every failed build in Slack before a person looks at it.
steps: Trigger: your CI POSTs the repository, run URL and commit SHA of a failed build to the webhook.
Diagnose the failure: Claude Code reads the failing job's log and the commit's diff through the tools of the GitHub MCP server in its MCP Servers slot, and writes a short diagnosis.
Post the diagnosis to Slack: send the run URL and the diagnosis to the channel.
